description: This PHP source file defines the 'File' class, which extends the 'Basic' class, in the SuiteCRM project. It manages file-related data and behaviors, including saving, retrieving, and deleting attachments, and handles preview settings and URL generation within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class representing a file attachment, with properties for file metadata and methods to handle file operations such as saving, retrieval, and deletion within the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent Basic class constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the parent save method to set the filename from the upload file before saving.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields such as image URLs and preview flags based on file extension and MIME type.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the file record, ensuring the document name is correctly assigned to the name property.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes the associated file attachment from the filesystem, handling unlinking and cleanup.
